snippet.title: Dupery – Launch Date Trailer
snippet.description:
A solo deduction roguelite with over 175 roles, set in a noir city run by a criminal syndicate. Investigate everyone, make arrests and protect your reputation. Take down the syndicate and don’t get duped like the rest. Everyone is a suspect, trust no one. No friends required.

Wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3845070/Dupery_A_Game_of_Solo_Deduction/
